fact: The Auditor General's report on the 2024 accounts audits the SAP-based IFMIS and the PMEC payroll system at the Ministry of Finance and National Planning in operation in 2024, and finds no off-site backup for either as at 31 August 2025.
title: Report of the Auditor General on the Accounts of the Republic for the Financial Year Ended 31st December 2024
publisher: Office of the Auditor General, Republic of Zambia
